thesis: Cross-disciplinary measures and thought experiments have bounded inferential scope.

ideas.statement: Population-dependent genetic scores, clinical categories and cultural identities cannot be interchanged.
AI futures are deliberate thought experiments based on observable mechanisms, not predictions.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Contemporary data cannot be directly projected onto ancient civilizations; genetic signals can fit multiple social histories.
Number of children only approximates long-term fitness.

audit.notes: Entire assigned batch read; numbered subchapters covered; no independent citation verification.
